title: Three.js
summary: 3D on the deep navy ground: white and cyan line forms, slow and quiet, with at most one highlighter accent.
usage: {"piece": "three/hoop"}; every scene takes "field": "noir" (default), "bone" or a footage tone (sky, meadow, stone, dusk) and "accent". Data and text are props: {"piece": "three/thin-bars", "props": {"items": [{"label": "A", "value": 3}]}}. Files: library/themes/psychedelic/three/pieces/ (_studio.js is the shared studio stage, not a piece).

items.name: Silk sheet
items.description: A pale sheet of cloth hanging in the dark, rolling slowly as if in a draught (loop). Props: field, tilt, amount.

items.name: Bokeh drift
items.description: Soft out-of-focus discs of light drifting across the dark, one of them highlighter (loop): a ground for one white word. Props: count, partners (adds a cyan and a sun disc), seed.

items.name: Wire horizon
items.description: A hairline floor running to the horizon under a thin wire globe turning slowly, one meridian in highlighter (loop). Props: globe, rows, lines.

items.name: Hoops
items.description: Thin hoops turning slowly inside one another like a mobile, a small highlighter bead riding the inner one (loop). Props: rings, word (small print underneath).

items.name: Panel row
items.description: The theme’s vertical-panel motif: tall cards of unequal width slide in from above and below at their own pace and close up into a row, one in highlighter. Props: widths, accentAt, height, gap, speed, times.

items.name: Floating card
items.description: One clean card floating over the out-of-focus ground, tilting a few degrees as it settles, carrying a tall condensed word, a hairline and small print. Props: word, kicker, note, paper, ratio, speed.

items.name: Thin bars
items.description: A bar chart as a row of thin standing blades on a hairline floor, figures in thin tall numerals above; the tallest (or highlight) is highlighter. Props: items [{label, value}], title, highlight, max, prefix, suffix, decimals, speed, times.
